game_concept: A survival strategy set in The Kingdom – Moat Bridge, the drawbridge over the moat: the town guard must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Inventory Slots: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against rogue crows.
theme: The Kingdom – Moat Bridge: the drawbridge over the moat
core_gameplay_loop: In Moat Bridge, repeat each round: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against rogue crows. Each round, rogue crows strike the granary door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the potion value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the granary door from rogue crows in Moat Bridge: keep the potion meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 71-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: potion drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 71-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 8 (extended tier): Inventory Slots
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Inventory Slots' (Week 1 slot 8), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Moat Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potion changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Moat Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 71 seconds while potion > 0.
